wiki.title: Evan Vickers
wiki.extract: Evan J. Vickers is an American politician and a Republican member of the Utah State Senate representing District 28 since January 1, 2013. Vickers previously served in the Utah State Legislature from January 1, 2009, until December 31, 2012, in the Utah House of Representatives District 72 seat. He got re-elected on November 8, 2022 and will serve until December 31, 2026
